description: Email templates following Nate Herk's personalization at scale methodology

templates.name: Discovery - Local Business Growth
templates.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

I came across {{companyName}} while researching businesses in {{location}} and was impressed by {{aiInsight}}.

I work with companies in the {{industry}} sector helping them {{painPoint}}. Many businesses we work with in {{canton}} have seen significant improvements in [specific metric].

{{recentNews}}

Would you be open to a brief conversation about how we might help {{companyName}} achieve similar results?

No pressure - just thought it might be worth exploring.

Best regards,
{{senderName}}

P.S. {{aiInsight}} - this really caught my attention about your business.

templates.name: Value Proposition - Direct Benefit
subject_lines: {{firstName}}, your competitors in {{canton}} are doing this
templates.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

I'll get straight to the point:

I noticed {{companyName}} is in the {{industry}} space in {{location}}. Based on what I've seen, here are 3 opportunities that could help:

1. {{painPoint}}
2. [Specific opportunity based on industry]
3. [Competitive advantage possibility]

{{aiInsight}}

We've helped similar businesses in {{canton}} achieve [specific result]. Would a 15-minute call be useful to explore if this makes sense for {{companyName}}?

You can reply to this email or grab a time here: [calendar link]

Cheers,
{{senderName}}

P.S. Even if the timing isn't right, I'd be happy to share some insights about what's working in your industry right now.

templates.name: Social Proof - Local Success Stories
templates.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

I wanted to reach out because we recently worked with [similar company] in {{canton}} and the results were remarkable:

• [Specific metric improvement]
• [Another concrete result]
• [Third impressive outcome]

They were facing {{painPoint}} - which I imagine might resonate with challenges at {{companyName}}.

{{aiInsight}}

Given your position in {{location}}'s {{industry}} sector, I thought you might find their approach interesting.

Would you like me to send over the case study? Or if you prefer, we could have a quick call to discuss how it might apply to {{companyName}}.

What works better for you?

Best,
{{senderName}}

P.S. No strings attached - even if we never work together, I think you'd find the insights valuable.

followup_templates.name: Gentle Follow-up
subject_lines: Did you get a chance to see this, {{firstName}}?
followup_templates.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

I know you're busy, so I'll keep this brief.

I reached out last week about helping {{companyName}} with {{painPoint}}. I totally understand if the timing isn't right or if it's not a fit.

If you're interested, I'd still love to have that conversation. If not, just let me know and I won't bother you again.

Either way, I hope {{companyName}} continues to thrive in {{location}}.

Best,
{{senderName}}

followup_templates.name: Value-Add Follow-up
followup_templates.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

I wanted to follow up, but rather than just asking again, I thought I'd share something that might be immediately useful for {{companyName}}:

[Specific tip, resource, or insight related to their industry]

This has been working really well for other {{industry}} businesses in {{canton}}.

Still happy to chat if you'd like to explore how we could help {{companyName}} specifically, but either way, hope this is helpful.

Best,
{{senderName}}

P.S. If you're not interested in hearing from me, just reply with "not interested" and I'll remove you from my list immediately.

followup_templates.name: Break-up Email
followup_templates.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

I've reached out a couple of times about helping {{companyName}} with {{painPoint}}, but I haven't heard back.

That's totally fine - I know things get busy and this might not be a priority right now.

I'm going to assume it's not a fit and won't reach out again unless you tell me otherwise.

If I'm wrong and you're still interested, just reply to this email and we can set up that call.

Either way, I wish you and {{companyName}} all the best in {{location}}.

Cheers,
{{senderName}}

interested_reply.subject: Re: {{originalSubject}}
interested_reply.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

Thanks for getting back to me! I'm excited to chat.

Here's my calendar link: [calendar link]

Or if you prefer, I'm available:
• [Time slot 1]
• [Time slot 2]
• [Time slot 3]

Just let me know what works best for you.

Looking forward to it!

{{senderName}}

not_interested_reply.subject: Re: {{originalSubject}}
not_interested_reply.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

No problem at all - I appreciate you letting me know.

I've removed you from my outreach list. You won't hear from me again unless you reach out.

If anything changes in the future, feel free to reach back out.

Best of luck with {{companyName}}!

{{senderName}}

timing_reply.subject: Re: {{originalSubject}}
timing_reply.body:
Hi {{firstName}},

Totally understand - timing is everything!

When would be a better time for me to check back in? I'm happy to reach out in [timeframe] if that works better.

Just let me know and I'll make a note.

Thanks!

{{senderName}}

subject_line_tips: Avoid spam trigger words (free, guarantee, act now)
body_tips: Keep under 150 words for initial outreach
Personalize at least 3 elements per email
Add a P.S. with additional personalization

compliance.gdpr_notice: By sending to EU contacts, you must comply with GDPR requirements including legitimate interest justification and easy opt-out mechanism.
